scoring_justification: Full simulation recompute is infeasible in verifier sandbox; instead we recompute the four headline metrics from the agent's raw CSV and compare to paper-reported values with tolerances, plus structural checks on curve shape.

hidden_assets.purpose: gold metric values for V_oc, I_sc, P_max, eta_max
hidden_assets.source_provenance: paper main claim: 'When the hot water temperature is 100 °C, the open circuit voltage is 1.80 V, the short circuit current is 0.28 A, the maximum power output of 0.13 W and the maximum efficiency of 0.87%'.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: these are the paper's directly reported headline numbers

outputs.description: CSV file containing the performance sweep of the TEG module. Columns: I (A), V (V), P (W), eta (dimensionless), T_h (K), T_c (K). At least 20 data rows. The checker will verify column existence, data types, and structural consistency (e.g. V monotonically decreasing with I).

JSON object containing the extracted headline performance metrics from the simulation. The checker will compare these values to hidden reference values with appropriate tolerances (meeting or exceeding the reference for power and efficiency).

output_contract.notes: The simulation must reproduce the performance of the Ferrotec 8001/127/040B module with the specified heat exchanger and water temperatures. The checker will validate the CSV structure, recompute V_oc, I_sc, P_max, eta_max from the CSV, and compare both the self-consistency between the CSV and JSON and the JSON values against hidden reference values.

steps.description: Validate CSV shape, columns, monotonic V, non-negative P/eta, T_h > T_c.
Recompute V_oc, I_sc, P_max, eta_max from CSV, verify JSON consistency, compare to gold tolerances.
